Title: Repo setup, monorepo structure and GitHub Actions CI
Body: Create the project skeleton (server/ = Node.js Express API, client/ = React 18 + Vite + Tailwind) and automate checks on every pull request.

Title: PostgreSQL schema per SAD: users, laboratories, equipment, reservations, audit_logs
Body: Create the relational schema exactly as specified in SAD section 6. Merge this first after repo setup; everything depends on it.

Title: Authentication and role-based access control (JWT)
Body: Backend login with bcrypt-hashed passwords and JWT, plus middleware that protects routes by role.

Title: Seed data: laboratories, equipment, users
Body: Create repeatable sample data that matches the Test Plan.

Title: Equipment list: API and React page with status and calibration badge
Body: Authenticated users see the equipment catalogue with live status and calibration state.

Title: Equipment search and filtering
Body: Search by keyword and filter by laboratory/department, availability and calibration status. Implements the Search / Filter use case including the no-match alternate flow.

Title: Real-time slot availability and alternatives
Body: Show free and booked slots for a piece of equipment across the next 7 days, and suggest alternatives when a slot is taken.

Title: React app shell: login page, routing and reservation form
Body: Frontend foundation: login page, protected routes, navigation, and the reservation form (equipment, date, start, end). Booking should take 5 steps or fewer.

Title: Validate max 2-hour duration and 7-day booking window
Body: Reject reservations that break the duration or advance-booking rules on the server and in the form.

Title: Calibration verification before confirming a reservation
Body: Block reservations for equipment that is not AVAILABLE or whose calibration expires before the slot ends.

Title: Overlap prevention using the database exclusion constraint
Body: Two students must never hold overlapping slots on the same equipment. The database constraint is the final guard.

Title: Reservation endpoint: transaction, row lock and token
Durability: reservations and tokens survive logout, refresh and restart
Body: Make sure confirmed reservations are committed and persisted, and prove it with a restart test.

Title: My Reservations: API and React page
Body: Students view their own reservations with token, equipment and time. (Cancel is Sprint-2.)

Title: Return equipment: POST /reservations/:id/return
Late-return detection: is_late, LATE_RETURNED, late_return_count
Technician role routes and RBAC hardening
Technician updates equipment status (PUT /equipment/:id)
Technician updates calibration expiration
Technician global reservation overview (GET /technician/reservations)
Concurrency hardening: row lock + exclusion under load
Race and load tests: 100 concurrent requests, p95 under 200 ms
Security hardening: rate limiting, CORS whitelist, XSS sanitisation, audit log writes
Automated test suite and 80% coverage reported in CI
Documentation: README, SRS/SAD updates, deviations
Cancel upcoming reservation (frees the slot)
Notification adapter (non-blocking events)
Final demo video, bug fixes and development freeze
